name: open-brx
description: Root build entry. Cloudflare Workers Builds runs `npm run build:ci`: it builds the phone HUD bundle (app/www, embedded on the landing as a live demo), then renders docs/platform/*.md and docs/manual/*.md into webapp/.

scripts.build: cd app && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && cd ../site && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && node build.mjs
scripts.build:ci: cd app && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && cd ../site && npm ci --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund && node build.mjs
